meta.name: Doozie's Doghouse
meta.description: Dog-loving Doozie uses her creativity and imagination during playtime with her puppy pals.

videos.title: You Be You!
videos.overview: Doozie tours the doghouse and the many places to play, then meets puppy friends and designs cool T-shirts for their stylish pal Seaquin's fashion show.

videos.title: Puggie Loses His Snortle
videos.overview: Part snort, part giggle, entirely adorable! Puggie has lost his silly snortle, but Doozie's on the case while playing puppy doctor in the doghouse.

videos.title: Puppy Cat Playdate
videos.overview: Bow-wow meets meow, meow! Older sis Gabby and her kitty pals stop by the doghouse for a day of puppy-cat playdates to the farm, under the sea and more.

videos.title: Meet the Hamster Pups
videos.overview: Yummy Zone, Puppy Patch, Game Zone? Doozie and her crew need to find the perfect place in the doghouse for a basketful of cute hamster puppies.

videos.title: Glow Cruise
videos.overview: Get your glow on! Join Doozie, Puggie and Seaquin for a special ride on PixiePup's glittering glow cruise in the doghouse's Puppy Patch.

videos.title: Mission ImPAWsible
videos.overview: With cool glasses and an awesome gadget, Doozie and Puggie drop into the doghouse as puppy agents to solve problems and save CreamPup, GamePup and pals.

videos.title: Pixie's Wishing Day
videos.overview: It's the most magical day of the year! Pixie grants wishes to the pups in the doghouse and gets help from Doozie when she runs out of magic.
